Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2. Must be the first field in message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Must be second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Not listed in the document header table; FIX 4.2 standard header field, third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Message sequence number.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: SenderCompID as assigned by NASDAQ; four to six characters. The SenderCompID returned within all messages is PHLX, NSDQ, ISE, GMNI or MCRY.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: PHLX, NSDQ, ISE, GMNI or MCRY.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: It must be 4 characters if present. Will use default Firm Mnemonic if not provided. Invalid values will lead to reject. Used to route orders on behalf of multiple members over one connection. RFP Notification messages do not include any firm identifiers in Tag 50.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Always required for retransmitted messages, whether prompted by the sending system or as the result of a resend request.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Not listed in the document header table; FIX 4.2 standard required header field.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for message resends. If data is not available set to same value as SendingTime.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Three-digit character. Must be last field in the message

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message (section 4.1.1: see FIX Protocol ver. 4.2).

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: TestRequest
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier included in the Test Request message to be returned in the resulting Heartbeat. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: ResendRequest
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent; 0 for infinity. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: Reject
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Invalid message types are rejected via Reject.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: The tag number of the FIX field being referenced. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message being referenced. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Where possible, message to explain reason for rejection. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: SequenceReset
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Indicates that the Sequence Reset message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New sequence number. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: Logout
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: The first message should be a logon message. No additional messages should be transmitted until NASDAQ has verified the SenderCompID and a logon is received from NASDAQ. NASDAQ does not support encryption.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Not listed in the document Logon table; FIX 4.2 standard required field. NASDAQ does not support encryption: 0 = None.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval in seconds.

Message.Name: NewOrderSingle
Message.Description: Broker Dealers who wish to electronically submit securities orders to NASDAQ for execution use the new order message type. Orders can be submitted with special handling instructions and execution instructions. New Order messages received with a duplicate ClOrdID will be ignored, regardless of if the PossResend flag is set. In case of absence of TimeInForce (59) the order is treated as DAY. In NOM, attributable orders and block orders are not supported and ExposureFlag (9203) is ignored.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Must be 10 characters or less.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by institution. Must be 30 characters or less or will be rejected

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Can contain only one instruction. f = InterMarket Sweep Order (ISO) G = All Or None (AON)

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Required. Acceptable range is 1 to 999999. No commas, decimals or spaces allowed, nor are negative numbers.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Valid values: 1 = Market 2 = Limit 3 = Stop 4= Stop Limit

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Required if OrdType = 2 or 4. 1-10 character decimal price. "12.34" is the correct presentation of twelve dollars and thirty-four cents. Order will be rejected if this tag is present and OrdType (40) =1 or 3 for Market or Stop.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order. Valid values: 1 = Buy 2 = Sell

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: 1 - 6 character Options Root Symbol. Spaces, periods, commas not allowed.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Firms can use this field in order message to supply optional clearing data field that is sent to OCC. If field is supplied, NASDAQ will allow only 13 characters and use it for supplementary ID in the order.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect. Absence of this field is interpreted as Day. Valid values: 0 = Market Hours (DAY) 1 = Good Till Cancel (GTC) 2 = OPG (Open Cross) 3 = Immediate or Cancel (IOC) 4 = Fill Or Kill 6 = Good Till Date (GTD)

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: YYYYMMDD-HH-mm:SS.sss (milliseconds) YYYYMMDD-HH-mm:SS.sss.sssssssss (nanoseconds) Firm can configure by port to use nanoseconds or milliseconds

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: 1 <= n <= 99999 Give-up Note: Can be used to override default Give-up on order by order basis.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: O = opening position C = closing position

Field.Name: AllocAccount
Field.Description: Exchange Internal Firm Identifier of the Preferenced Participant for Preferenced Order Flow; should not exceed 3 characters.

Field.Name: StopPx
Field.Description: Required if OrdType =3 or 4. Order will be rejected if this tag is present and if OrdType (40) is not 3 or 4.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Display Quantity for Reserve Orders

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: 0 = put 1 = call

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike Price for option: Valid values: 0 - 999999.99999999

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: 0 = Customer 1 = Firm 5 = Nasdaq registered Market Maker 2 = Broker Dealer 8 = Professional Customer 4 = Other exchange registered Market Maker 7 = Joint Back Office Not supported on ISE, GEMX or MRX at this time

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: If provided, must match target exchange from below: 1 = AMEX Z = BATS B = BSE C = C2 W = CBOE Y = ISE X = PHLX N = NYSE Q = NASDAQ T = NTX Options 7 = MIAX H = ISE GEMINI E = BATS EDGX J = ISE MERCURY P = MIAX PEARL D= MIAX Emerald U = MEMX S = MIAX Sapphire V = IEX G = MX2 If not provided will default to the local exchange

Field.Name: ExpireDate
Field.Description: Required if TimeInForce = 6 (GTD). (In YYYYMMDD format)

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CMTA Number (firm that will clear the trade) up to 5-character numeric. If this tag is not supplied, this order will not be a CMTA.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: OCC Sub-account. Required when CustomerOrFirm =4 or 5 Four characters are accepted

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: Month, Day, and Year of the maturity in YYYYMMDD format.

Field.Name: RoutingStrategy
Field.Description: "DNR" "SRCH" "FIND" "POST"

Field.Name: DisplayWhen
Field.Description: 1=Immediate 2=Exhaust Required for Reserve Orders

Field.Name: DisplayRange
Field.Description: Random Refresh Quantity for Reserve Orders

Field.Name: ExposureFlag
Field.Description: Attributable orders: Note: Below fields can be provided on dissemination of an order C=Customer ID E=Expose All G=Give-up M=CMTA Block orders: Note: Suppression of Block Side/Price/Size is enabled (including the above) H=Hide All I=Instruction (Buy/Sell) P=Premium (Limit Price) Q=Quantity

Field.Name: BrokerPCT
Field.Description: 0 <== n <== 40 (default value = 40) Used for RFP by the Responder

Field.Name: RFPID
Field.Description: Unique identifier assigned by the exchange. Used for RFP by the Responder

Field.Name: RFPInstr
Field.Description: Required for initiating and RFP Valid Values: B = Interact with Book upon unsuccessful RFP attempt C = Cancel back upon unsuccessful RFP attempt Phlx, NOM, ISE, MRX and GEMX will not support RFP on FIX

Field.Name: AuctionID
Field.Description: Numeric auction id that this order is joining. When AuctionType is provided, AuctionID must be provided in order to respond to an auction. If RFPID and AuctionID are provided, the response will be rejected. NOTE: If this field is specified, but AuctionType is not specified then this order will be rejected. Phlx, NOM, ISE, MRX and GEMX will support auction responses on FIX. RFP is not supported at this time.

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: Auction type for this order. Valid values: 'P' = PIM 'B' = Block Auction 'X' = Flex Auction 'F' = Facilitation Auction 'S' = Solicitation Auction If the order is a response to an auction type listed above or an RFP, this field must be specified. Phlx, NOM, ISE, MRX and GEMX will support auction responses on FIX. RFP is not supported at this time.

Field.Name: AuctionDuration
Field.Description: Must be provided for Flex Instruments and it should be between 3,000 and 300,000 ms

Field.Name: StepUpPriceType
Field.Description: 1= Market 2= Limit Required when tag 9044 is provided

Field.Name: StepUpPrice
Field.Description: Only provided when StepUpPriceType =2 and price must be at or better than original auction price. Order will be rejected if provided and StepupPriceType (9043)=1 for Market
